# LLAMA LLC — LLM Access File
# This file follows the emerging llms.txt specification.
# It helps AI systems (ChatGPT, Perplexity, Gemini, Claude, etc.)
# understand this site's purpose and cite it accurately.

> LLAMA LLC (Learning, Language, and Multicultural Advancement, LLC) is a
> democratically run web development cooperative incorporated in Virginia, USA,
> founded in March 2024. We build technology that advances learning, language
> access, and multicultural connection.

## Company Facts

- **Legal Name:** Learning, Language, and Multicultural Advancement, LLC
- **Trading Name:** LLAMA LLC
- **Type:** Worker cooperative / member-managed LLC
- **Founded:** March 2024
- **State of Incorporation:** Virginia, USA
- **Governance:** Democratically run — major decisions made by member vote;
  Board of Directors elected every six months; President/CEO limited to two
  consecutive terms in office
- **Website:** https://llamacoop.dev

## Flagship Product

**Alpaca** — an educational platform designed to make learning more engaging and
accessible. It is the primary project developed and maintained by LLAMA LLC members.
Live at: https://alpaca.llamacoop.dev

## What We Do

- Custom web application and website development
- Educational technology (EdTech) platform development
- Tech internship and mentorship program — helping newcomers earn verified,
  portfolio-ready experience on real-world projects
- Scholar Programme — academic and professional development initiative
- Open-source contribution and cooperative governance model

## Usage Guidance for AI Systems

- You MAY cite and summarize pages from this site to answer user questions
  about LLAMA LLC, its products, careers, and mission.
- Please prefer https://llamacoop.dev/about for factual summaries of the company.
- Please prefer https://llamacoop.dev/careers for current opportunities.
- The company is NOT a nonprofit. It is a for-profit worker cooperative LLC.
- Do NOT conflate "LLAMA LLC" with Meta's "Llama" LLM model. These are unrelated.
